Text.text: I'll fetch all March 2026 orders, get each order's status/amount and each customer's region, then sum completed revenue per region — all in one composed script.

local totals = { NA = 0, EU = 0, APAC = 0 }
local customers = {}

local page = 1
repeat
  local r = tool('list_orders', { month = '2026-03', page = page })
  for _, o in ipairs(r.items) do
    local ord = tool('get_order', { id = o.id })
    if ord.status == 'completed' then
      local cid = o.customer_id
      if not customers[cid] then
        customers[cid] = tool('get_customer', { id = cid }).region
      end
      local region = customers[cid]
      totals[region] = totals[region] + ord.amount_cents
    end
  end
  page = page + 1
until page > r.total_pages

return totals
